data.one_liner: Renders Apple Watch-style circular progress rings with customizable colors and gradients.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to display circular progress bars resembling Apple Watch activity rings. It supports multi-ring wrapping when progress exceeds 100%, allowing custom colors and gradients for each layer. It can also render child widgets in the center of the ring.
use_when: Building fitness or activity tracking interfaces that emulate Apple Watch rings.
Displaying progress that can exceed 100% and wrap into multiple overlapping concentric rings.
avoid_when: Needing non-circular progress indicators like linear bars.
Relying on auto-brightening colors with more than 3 rings, as it triggers a runtime exception.
strengths: Supports multiple overlapping laps/rings when percent exceeds 100%.
Flexible color schemes supporting solid colors, single gradients, and distinct gradients per ring layer.
Easily nests custom child widgets inside the ring center.
weaknesses: Known runtime exception if auto-brightening colors exceed 3 rings.
Lacks comprehensive automated tests and test coverage as noted in the roadmap.

alternatives.name: percent_indicator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers broader options including standard circular and linear progress indicators with mature community support.

data.minimal_example:
Ring(
  percent: 90,
  color: RingColorScheme(ringColor: Colors.red),
  radius: 80,
  width: 10,
  child: Center(child: Text('90%')),
)
